about_the_game:
A powerful set of items that will come in handy in the early to mid-game.

Hero's Cloak EX
Faint Hope+
Star of Destiny
Crimson Guidebook: Dance

*Can also be obtained in-game.
*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*Crimson Guidebook teaches a Skill. If you have already learned the Skill, this item will be redeemed as a Lightning Shard.
*Please note that all items in excess of the maximum amount will be lost.
